title: 50 API Interview Questions: Backend & SDE Handbook
summary: The 50 most asked API interview questions for backend/SDE roles, from REST and HTTP basics through auth, security, pagination, rate limiting, caching, webhooks, versioning, scalability and real-world design scenarios. Each page packs three or four questions with short answers, key points and a quick visual.

chapters.title: 50 API Interview Questions
points: Cover: 50 questions on 14 themed pages
Topics: REST, HTTP, auth, security, pagination, rate limiting, caching, webhooks, design
Format per question: short answer, key points, visual
Ordered from fundamentals to scenarios

chapters.title: REST Fundamentals
points: What is a REST API and what are its architectural constraints?
What is the difference between REST and SOAP?
What does it mean for an API to be stateless, and why does it matter?

chapters.title: HTTP Methods
points: What is the difference between PUT and PATCH?
What is the difference between POST and PUT?
Which HTTP methods are safe and which are idempotent?

chapters.title: Status Codes
points: What is the difference between 401 and 403?
What is the difference between 400, 422 and 409?
When do you return 200, 201, 202 and 204?

chapters.title: HTTP Headers and Content
points: What is content negotiation and which headers drive it?
What is the difference between Cache-Control, ETag and Last-Modified?
What happens in an HTTP request from browser to server and back?

chapters.title: Authentication Basics
points: What is the difference between authentication and authorization?
What is the difference between session-based and token-based authentication?
What are API keys and when are they enough?

chapters.title: JWT and OAuth 2.0
points: How does a JWT work and what are its three parts?
How do you handle JWT expiry, refresh tokens and revocation?
What are the OAuth 2.0 grant types and when is each used?
What is the difference between OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect?

chapters.title: CORS and API Security
points: What is CORS and how does a preflight request work?
How do you protect an API from SQL injection, XSS and CSRF?
What is the OWASP API Security Top 10 and which risks matter most?
What is BOLA/IDOR and how do you prevent it?

chapters.title: Pagination and Filtering
points: What is the difference between offset and cursor pagination?
Why does offset pagination get slow on large tables?
How do you design filtering, sorting and field selection in a REST API?
How do you paginate a feed where new items are inserted constantly?

chapters.title: Rate Limiting and Throttling
points: How does rate limiting work and why is it needed?
What is the difference between token bucket, leaky bucket and sliding window?
How do you implement distributed rate limiting across servers?
What does a 429 response look like and how should clients react?

chapters.title: Caching and API Gateway
points: What are the layers where an API response can be cached?
How do you invalidate a cache and keep it consistent?
What does an API gateway do and when do you need one?
What is the difference between an API gateway, reverse proxy and load balancer?

chapters.title: Idempotency and Webhooks
points: What is idempotency and how do you make a POST idempotent?
How do you prevent duplicate payments when a client retries?
What is the difference between webhooks and polling?
How do you design reliable and secure webhook delivery?

chapters.title: Versioning, Uploads and Errors
points: What are the ways to version an API and which do you prefer?
How do you make API changes without breaking existing clients?
How do you design file uploads for large files?
How do you design a consistent API error response format?

chapters.title: Testing and Monitoring
points: How do you test an API: unit, integration, contract and load tests?
Which metrics and logs do you monitor for an API in production?
What is the difference between REST, GraphQL and gRPC?

chapters.title: Scalability and Design Scenarios
points: How do you scale an API to handle millions of requests per day?
How would you design a URL shortener API?
How would you design a notification or payment API?
How do you handle partial failures, timeouts and retries between services?
